backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing user profiles, service requests, technicians, feedback, and inventory with access control and helper utilities.
feature_evidence.json: Evidence report mapping features to impacted frontend files with metadata and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each major frontend file.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining light and dark OKLCH color tokens and applying global background and text settings.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the app and loading the main TypeScript bundle.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Configures TanStack Router with routes for home, request registration, success, details, user requests, and admin dashboard.
frontend/src/components/admin/InventoryS: Provides an inventory management panel for viewing, adding, and updating spare parts with low‑stock alerts.
frontend/src/components/admin/SparesUsag: Form for logging spare part usage tied to service requests, allowing technicians and items to be selected.
frontend/src/components/admin/Technician: Displays customer feedback and ratings for technicians with filtering and average rating calculation.
Displays technician assignment, completion, and pending stats by aggregating request data and showing them in a table.
Provides a dropdown selector populated with technicians fetched from the backend.
Lists all technicians and includes a form to add new technicians with name, phone, and notes.
frontend/src/components/admin/UsageRepor: Computes and displays spare‑part usage statistics based on inventory logs.
frontend/src/components/AppImage.tsx: Image component with lazy loading and a fallback container when loading fails.
frontend/src/components/BrandLogo.tsx: Displays the branding logo using AppImage with selectable sizes and fallback styling.
frontend/src/components/CategoryGrid.tsx: Renders clickable service category cards that navigate to the request registration page.
frontend/src/components/ContactInfoCompa: Compact contact info component showing email, phone, or location depending on mode and variant.
frontend/src/components/feedback/Feedbac: Allows customers to submit star ratings and comments for a service ticket.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Login/logout button integrating Internet Identity with loading and error handling states.
frontend/src/components/PageLayout.tsx: Defines the main app layout with header, routed content, and a footer containing company info, links, and social icons.
frontend/src/components/RequireAuth.tsx: Wraps protected content and prompts users to sign in using Internet Identity if not authenticated.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Renders the responsive site header with navigation, branding, admin-aware links, and mobile menu support.
frontend/src/constants/branding.ts: Defines static branding data such as logo paths and company contact details.
frontend/src/constants/serviceCategories: Exports service categories with metadata and provides helpers to look up category info by ID.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity authentication state, providing login, logout, and identity persistence across sessions.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for CRUD operations on requests, profiles, admin checks, and filtered data using an actor-based backend.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind layers and CSS variables for light and dark themes and applies base styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboardPage.ts: Admin dashboard displaying request metrics, filtering tools, and technician assignment features.
frontend/src/pages/AdminLoginPage.tsx: Login page using Internet Identity and admin verification before navigating to the admin dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with hero section, service categories, and feature highlights for booking service requests.
frontend/src/pages/MyRequestsPage.tsx: Authenticated user page listing and managing the user's submitted service requests.
frontend/src/pages/RegisterRequestPage.t: Form page for creating a new service request with validation, request submission, and redirect on success.
frontend/src/pages/RequestDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed information for a specific request, handling loading, errors, status badges, and feedback form.
frontend/src/pages/RequestSuccessPage.ts: Shows a confirmation page after submitting a request with navigation options to home or request details.
frontend/src/pages/ServicesPage.tsx: Lists appliance service categories and links users to the request registration page with a selected category.
frontend/src/pages/TrackStatusPage.tsx: Allows users to look up request status by ticket ID and phone number and displays results or errors.
Computes summary metrics such as counts of open, assigned, completed, and unassigned requests.
frontend/src/utils/adminRequestsView.ts: Provides search, filter, and sorting utilities for displaying request lists in admin views.
frontend/src/utils/brand.ts: Converts brand objects to strings and vice versa, including handling common predefined brands.
frontend/src/utils/csvExport.ts: Converts request objects into CSV format, escapes fields, and triggers a file download.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Provides timestamp formatting utilities for converting bigint nanosecond values to readable date strings.
frontend/src/utils/requestStatus.ts: Maps request status enums to user-facing labels and UI variant types.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Handles reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters, supporting both query and hash routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS theme extensions, colors, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, feature statuses, and configuration for the booking form update project.
